notes: Posted 6 August 2001, before Coruscant, with no Coruscant-set cards (the strategy expects 'the new LS hyperdrive objective in Coruscant'), so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Start': Bring Him Before Me ('BHBM'), Death Star II: Throne Room ('DS2throne'), Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion, Prepared Defenses ('prepped defenses'), Imperial Arrest Order ('IAO'), Mobilization Points ('Mob points') and I Will Find Them Quickly, Master; all count toward the 60.

The start line 'I will find them quickly master/if the trace was correct' names two cards: the Effect I Will Find Them Quickly, Master and the Epic Event If The Trace Was Correct (the draft's 'Mob points', 'IAO' and this pair were mis-parsed). Both are counted; the list totals 60.

Posted 'id just as soon mount a wookie' dested the Dark Hoth interrupt I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee; 'vader with stick' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'darklord' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'sim shady' Sim Aloo; 'mara' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (with 'mara stick', Mara Jade's Lightsaber); 'xizor' Prince Xizor.
